implementationLimits: Measured floor-to-floor height and total elevation are unavailable; seven visible bands and approximately 21 m are photo-based estimates only.
The source map contains one outer way and no independently verified wing IDs or inner-ring geometry; photo-suggested inner gardens are not cut into the GIS-faithful footprint.
The back facade, roof equipment internals, window dimensions, exact courtyard widths, lobby diameter and verified walking entrance are unmeasured.

Map GLBs use image-free MeshStandardMaterial colors and repeated geometry; reference PBR maps were not embedded because the photos are uncalibrated and the map asset pipeline rejects texture payloads.

definitionOfDone: Both GLBs preserve the exact 22 unique WGS84 footprint vertices (23 entries including the closing point), connected zigzag silhouette and source concave recesses.
The high-detail model reads as a seven-band residence group through repeated floor slabs, tiled/brick facade fields, glazed bays and balcony rails.
The visible warm-red core strips, pale roof blocks and inward rounded lobby remain recognizable without implying measured dimensions or independent building IDs.
No unverified courtyard ring, entrance, sub-building ID or height value is written to campus GIS or routing.
All surface geometry is self-authored, image-less GLB material; unknown back-side or roof detail remains simple and visibly approximate.

featureGroups.name: Connected zigzag footprint and recesses
qualityCriteria: All 22 unique source vertices remain exact in map coordinates.
Concave source recesses remain open in the top-view outline.
failureModes: one rectangular volume replaces several offset wings
invented inner rings change the source footprint

featureGroups.name: Connected wing and stair-core hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Each major wing is named and attached to its real parent shell.
Brick stair-core strips visibly divide the long elevations.
failureModes: red cores omitted or placed arbitrarily

featureGroups.name: Repeated floor, window and balcony systems
qualityCriteria: Approximately seven facade bands are visible as a visual estimate.
Window bays, floor edges and balcony railings repeat with stable spacing along every long facade.
failureModes: repeated floor count differs between wings

featureGroups.name: Observed tile, brick and glazing response
qualityCriteria: Warm-red masonry fields remain distinct from pale tile walls, blue-gray glass and light rails.
Lighting variation is procedural, not baked from the photograph.
failureModes: single flat color across all facades

featureGroups.name: Inward rounded lobby and entry canopy cue
qualityCriteria: A single shallow circular/glazed facade projection echoes the visible round lobby.
It is treated as visual detail, not a verified map entrance.
failureModes: the decorative canopy is treated as a routable entrance

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Conditional visual reconstruction: preserve the one source way, treat facade count/height and the rounded lobby as display estimates, and do not invent unverified inner rings.
